parsed.internal_thinking: My attempt to trade with Charlie failed because he doesn't have the brick I need. Looking at the board, no one has brick to trade. I have 3 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 2 Sheep. I need Brick to build a road towards Node 18. Since I cannot trade for it and cannot afford a bank trade (4:1) with my current resources, I have no legal build or trade actions that progress my position this turn. I will end my turn.
parsed.note_to_self: Charlie has no brick. I need to wait for a Brick 6 or Brick 10 roll to start moving towards Node 18.
parsed.say_outloud: Well, looks like the brick market is as dry as the desert. Good luck everyone.
